topic: Demonstration and explanation to carry out various flight servicing as per flight servicing schedule.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration and explanation to carry out various flight servicing as per flight servicing schedule.
specific_objectives: 21.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to explain about various types of Flight Servicing being carried out i.a.w flight servicing cards / Aircraft flight servicing manual.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a flight servicing schedule?
List three common types of flight servicing required after a flight.
Where is the official authority for flight servicing procedures documented?

topics: Definition and scope of flight servicing
Reference to Aircraft Flight Servicing Manual
development.content:
Definition and scope of flight servicing
Role of Flight Servicing Cards
Reference to Aircraft Flight Servicing Manual
Importance of scheduled maintenance
Safety considerations during servicing

Pre-flight servicing requirements
Post-flight servicing procedures
Inter-flight servicing checks
Documentation and logging
Defect reporting mechanisms

Fuel servicing protocols
Oil and fluid checks
Battery servicing procedures
Cabin pressure and environmental checks
Final walk-around inspection

summary_questions: Explain the difference between pre-flight and post-flight servicing.
How does the Flight Servicing Card guide the maintenance crew?
What steps are taken if a defect is found during servicing?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the importance of adhering to the flight servicing schedule as outlined in the Aircraft Flight Servicing Manual, linking it to operational safety and readiness for the next lesson on logbook entries.

pft_rows.syllabus: practical on making entries in: - Part 3 flight servicing log of MOD form A-700C for BFS/TRS/AFS, forecasting of servicing schedules / inspections due, in Part 6D, 6E & 6F, Entries of inspections due as per part 6 above, in Part 4 U/S log and how to clear the un-serviceability & re-forecasting, Filling of Part 6G, compass deviation log for making deviation coefficient entries.
pft_rows.references: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
